tier.description: Delivery service tier. CONSOLIDATED is delivery-promise's opt-in tier of a customer-chosen delivery day; a cart quotes it only when the quote asked for it, so a client that never asks never sees it.
tier.title: Tier

deliverByEarliest.description: First day of the offer's delivery window, a day of the destination's local calendar (the delivery station's time zone delivery-promise names on the window; UTC when it names none).

deliverByLatest.description: Last day of the offer's delivery window, a day of the destination's local calendar (the delivery station's time zone delivery-promise names on the window; UTC when it names none).

consolidationEligible.description: Present only for the tier CONSOLIDATED (delivery-promise ADR 0024), relayed as quoted - true when the chosen delivery day leaves the network at least one local day after the fastest feasible window to merge the order with others, false when the day is that window itself. Omitted for every other tier.

capacityBand.description: The capacity pressure delivery-promise read on the offer's window when it quoted it. AMPLE is below 60 percent utilisation, TIGHT from 60 to below 85, SCARCE from 85. A signal only; it changes no offer, window or order, and the network computes no fee from it.
capacityBand.title: CapacityBand
